name: Singapore University of Technology and Design
summary: Singapore design, AI and engineering university with five degrees of eight terms; the first terms are shared before you join a pillar.

ib.text: No minimum IB total or subject is published; applications are reviewed on academic and non-academic record. May sitters apply on school-attested predicted results and must authorise the IB to release transcripts.

programmes.name: Architecture and Sustainable Design
programmes.about: A digital-era architecture degree built around the design studio sequence, with core subjects in design computation, building technology and history, theory and culture, ending in a capstone and option studios.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to SUTD, not to a degree. Academics and non-academic record are reviewed together; shortlisted applicants have a conversation session.

programmes.name: Computer Science and Design
programmes.about: A computing-intensive engineering degree under the ISTD pillar: a 60-credit computer science core, electives and tracks such as AI, data analytics, security and software engineering, plus humanities and social sciences.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to SUTD, not to a degree. Academics and non-academic record are reviewed together; shortlisted applicants have a conversation session.

programmes.name: Design and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Combines AI with an understanding of people, business and society to design human-centred solutions; the 2026 curriculum is open to students from science, non-science and hybrid backgrounds.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to SUTD, not to a degree. Academics and non-academic record are reviewed together; shortlisted applicants have a conversation session.

programmes.name: Engineering Product Development
programmes.about: Design and build intelligent products that sense, think and act in the real world, learning through hands-on projects from day one, with AI woven into the courses rather than a separate track.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to SUTD, not to a degree. Academics and non-academic record are reviewed together; shortlisted applicants have a conversation session.

programmes.name: Engineering Systems and Design
programmes.about: Model, analyse and optimise large-scale systems such as transport and supply chains; an 84-credit core of methods courses, then electives or a track such as aviation systems or financial services.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to SUTD, not to a degree. Academics and non-academic record are reviewed together; shortlisted applicants have a conversation session.

notes: EU students can take the MOE Tuition Grant, which cuts the fee but requires you to work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduating.
The form asks for personal insight answers, up to two referees and your leadership, research or community achievements; English test scores are needed if English was not your language of instruction.
Shortlisted May sitters on predicted results may be invited to the SUTD University Entrance Examination for early consideration; final IB results are due within 3 days of release in July.
